subject: Draft: Technical evaluation milestone (MAP) — post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@acmehealth.ai>, Alice M. <alice.platform@acmehealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Draft: Technical evaluation milestone (MAP) — post-call recap & next steps

Hi Priya / Alice —

Thanks for the call earlier today. Quick recap and a draft milestone for the Mutual Action Plan focused on the technical evaluation (see attached MAP v1). I want to make sure we have aligned success criteria and a clean hand-off for the benchmark run.

Summary (agreed on call)
- Goal: Validate an inference configuration that meets latency and cost targets for Acme Health's triage use case (mostly short prompts, avg 120 tokens per request).
- Deliverable for this milestone: Technical evaluation report with p95 latency, cost-per-1M-tokens estimate, qualitative output checks across 100 sample prompts, and model/recommendation.

Draft milestone: Technical evaluation plan
- Kickoff: Redwood to start environment prep once Acme provides sample dataset + traffic profile (deadline: 2026-06-10).
- Success criteria:
  * p95 latency <= 180ms for 1-2 concurrent token streams (95th percentile across synthetic mix)
  * Average cost <= $120 per 1M tokens (in our dedicated baseline config)
  * Output quality: >= 88% acceptable on Acme's rubric across 100 test prompts (we'll use the rubric you shared today)
- Model shortlist to test: OpenModel-X-45B, Llama-2-70B-Chat, Redwood-1.3-quant (we'll test float and quantized variants where feasible)
- Responsibilities:
  * Acme: provide sample prompts, label rubric file, and a platform eng contact for access (Gonzalo listed today).
  * Redwood (Connor): benchmarking scripts, infra config, run and collect metrics.
  * Redwood (Jordan/Marissa): commercial summary, cost estimates, and MAP updates.
- Timeline: benchmark runs complete by 2026-06-17, internal review 2026-06-18–19, recommendation and decision checkpoint by 2026-06-23. Target close date for MAP: 2026-07-01.
- Dependencies / risks:
  * Delayed sample data or missing rubric -> shifts schedule by ~1 week.
  * Need temporary dedicated capacity for reproducible latency tests; Connor will request a small reserved pool for the run.

Attachments: MAP v1 (high-level milestones + owner columns), benchmark script bundle (for your review)

Please confirm the dataset link and that the proposed timeline works for you.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@acmehealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 16:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Technical evaluation milestone (MAP) — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks Jordan — quick technical notes and clarifications from my side.

On Fri, Jun 5, 2026 at 3:02 PM Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com> wrote:
> Summary (agreed on call)
> - Goal: Validate an inference configuration that meets latency and cost targets for Acme Health's triage use case...

Notes / clarifications:
- Latency target: I put p95 <= 180ms as a conservative start. For small prompt sizes we may commonly see 120–150ms p95 on our optimized runtime; I'll try to hit <=150ms p95 on the optimistic config and keep the conservative 180ms in the MAP so expectations are clear.
- Cost baseline: our initial back-of-envelope uses dedicated GPUs at 70% utilization. I'll provide a detailed cost model (tokens -> compute-hours -> $) in the benchmark report.
- Model shortlist: suggest we prioritize testing OpenModel-X-45B (best latency/cost tradeoff), Redwood-1.3-quant (smallest memory footprint), and Llama-2-70B-Chat (quality check). If Acme wants, we can add a 13B variant for one quick compare.
- I attached the benchmark_script_v1.zip with the harness we discussed. It includes a reproducible config and metrics collector (p50/p95/p99, throughput, and token-level cost estimates).

Action items for Connor:
- Provision test pool & run smoke tests by 2026-06-11.
- Deliver benchmark report (metrics + config + recommendation) by 2026-06-17.

I'll start the capacity request now.

—Connor
Connor O'Brien
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
connor.obrien@redwood.com

From: Priya Natarajan <priya@acmehealth.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Cc: Gonzalo Rivera <gonzalo@acmehealth.ai>, Alice M. <alice.platform@acmehealth.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 08 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Technical evaluation milestone (MAP) — post-call recap & next steps

Thanks for the clear summary — this matches our understanding. A few quick confirmations from Acme: 

- Data: I've uploaded a sample set (~120 prompts + labels) and the rubric to the shared Drive folder (link below). Please use these exact prompts for the 100-prompt quality check.
- Procurement: Gonzalo is our procurement lead and will start the procurement checklist after we confirm the MAP. Expect him to reach out about NDAs and a short SOW.
- Timeline: 2026-06-17 benchmark complete works for us as long as we get interim smoke results by 2026-06-11.
- Questions: Can you confirm whether the benchmark runs will use a cached KV strategy for repeated prefixes? That matters for latency numbers.

Shared drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-acme-samples

Thanks — I'll loop Gonzalo once you confirm NDA/SOW next steps.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Head of Product | Acme Health
priya@acmehealth.ai
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@acmehealth.ai>, Gonzalo Rivera <gonzalo@acmehealth.ai>, Alice M. <alice.platform@acmehealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 09 Jun 2026 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft: Technical evaluation milestone (MAP) — post-call recap & next steps

Perfect — thanks Priya. Quick answers and next steps: 

- KV/cache: Connor confirms we'll run two passes: (A) cold-cache baseline and (B) cached prefix run (to show realistic production numbers for repeated prompts). We'll report both p95 buckets in the benchmark report.
- NDA / SOW: Marissa, I'll hand off to you to start the NDA and a short SOW with Gonzalo. Gonzalo — could you share the procurement contact email and preferred NDA template?
- Confirmed timeline:
  * Smoke run (smoke metrics + logs): 2026-06-11 (Connor)
  * Full benchmark complete + report: 2026-06-17 (Connor)
  * Internal review & recommend: 2026-06-18–19 (Jordan/Marissa/Connor)
  * MAP decision checkpoint w/ Acme: 2026-06-23
  * Target MAP close: 2026-07-01

I'll attach the MAP v1 spreadsheet here for visibility. Please comment in the 'owners' column if anything needs shifting.

Thanks everyone — pushing this over the finish line.

Jordan Blake
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com

Attachments: 20260605_MAP_v1.xlsx
